name: Bank of America Customized Cash Rewards Credit Card

intro_offer.headline: $200 online cash rewards bonus
intro_offer.spend_requirement: $1,000 in purchases in the first 90 days

rewards.on: the category of your choice: gas, online shopping, dining, travel, drug stores, or home improvement (up to $2,500 per quarter in combined choice category and grocery purchases)
grocery stores and wholesale clubs (up to $2,500 per quarter combined with the 3% category)

regular_apr: 18.24% to 28.24% variable, depending on your credit
intro_apr: 0% for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers
rating_reason: The flexible 3% category is useful for people with a single dominant spending area. The $2,500 quarterly combined cap means heavier spenders hit the limit and drop to 1% sooner.
best_for: Bank of America customers who qualify for the Preferred Rewards bonus
people with one clear high-spend category
skip_if: you spend heavily across multiple categories; a card with multiple fixed bonus categories will likely earn more
